page.layout: One page of text, a title page, centred; no margin notes. Blocks from top to bottom: title, dedication, imprint, printer line, privilege line. A library oval stamp and a circular seal sit over the text and are left out.
page.notes: Stamp: oval library stamp (BIBLIOTECA NAZ ROMA VITTORIO EMANUELE) over the Caro line; circular seal impression below Somasca line; the top is a dark printed or scanned band, not text. Lines "Ad vsum" and "Præside" are italic in the print; the ornamental "Ill.mo" line uses superscript "mo". Some letters are doubtful in the blurred Latin of the imprint.
